outcome: Disease recurrence status (intra-abdominal or multiple metastases)
cohort: One hundred nine uterine serous carcinoma patients diagnosed and surgically treated between December 2007 and June 2015 at Siriraj Hospital who achieved clinically complete response.
finding: Uterine serous carcinoma has a high 2-year recurrence rate of 35.8% and poor prognosis, with FIGO staging being the only factor associated with recurrence-free survival, and adjuvant chemotherapy showing survival benefits in early-stage disease.
